description: Issue #164, the other half: keeping every line for the comparison must not weaken the guard. #201's scope gate names the SAME 22 out-of-scope paths on both turns — more than the 20-line display window holds — and the loop is still cut short on turn 2 (2 sends, not 5), exactly as d61 pins for the small case. What the window costs is now COUNTED and NAMED wherever a list is shortened (the capped()/droppedNote() rule merge.mjs applies to PR bodies): the re-instruction says how many lines it left out, the scope_unsatisfiable detail says the same and states how many the guard compared, and the worker record keeps the fact so a report that lists 20 paths cannot be read as a run that had 20 violations.
